description.en:
Removes a Special Move from a player of one match team. It is the counterpart of CMND_BTL_LEARNING_SKILL.

With false as fourth argument, the move is removed for good:
- from the player's entry in the match team data (its six Special Move slots, SpecialMove1ID to SpecialMove6ID in the projectz BattlePlayer layout), with that slot's level reset to 1;
- from the player's saved data, in the same slot.
In every case it then updates the player on the pitch, but that step only concerns skill-effect moves (data record of type 15, carrying an effect type and a value). It clears whichever of the player's three effect slots holds that move's effect (the slots CMND_BTL_GET_SKILL_EFFECTIVE checks). The player's live list of six moves is not touched.
The shipped scripts always pass false, in BtlSetting (the pre-match setup callback), to take a move away from a player before the match.
Team of the player: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Parameter ID of the player, e.g. "para_cp0010".

false to remove the move for good (team data and saved data).
Omitted or true: only the pitch update described above runs.
Always null (also when fewer than 3 arguments are given).

examples.case: Taking a move away from the opponent before a story match (real usage, from btl0002.nut)
Finding which team the CPU plays before removing the move (real usage, from btl3001.nut)
